name: Richard Freeman
story: LINZ’s 2013 geospatial virtual field trip identified Richard Freeman as a cartographer. His appearance as a geospatial subject-matter expert gives a named practitioner connection between government digital mapping, chart and map production, and the effort to explain spatial careers to school students.
LINZ names Richard Freeman in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Cartographer, LINZ, 2013 VFT.
